snippet.title: American Truck Simulator - KRONE Agriculture Equipment
snippet.description:
The KRONE Agriculture Equipment DLC is now available for both American Truck Simulator and Euro Truck Simulator 2! 🙌 Expand your job roster with a powerful line-up of officially licensed KRONE farming machinery 🚜

Check out the bundle here: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/59743/KRONE_Agriculture_Equipment
Find the KRONE Agriculture Equipment for ATS on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3872930/American_Truck_Simulator__KRONE_Agriculture_Equipment/
Find the KRONE Agriculture Equipment for ETS2 on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3872920/Euro_Truck_Simulator_2__KRONE_Agriculture_Equipment/

Read more about this release at: https://blog.scssoft.com/2025/10/krone-agriculture-equipment-dlc-release.html
